normalized.description: In an era where secure, sovereign communications are paramount, the European Commission and the European Space Agency (ESA) are spearheading an ambitious initiative: IRIS (Infrastructure for Resilience, Interconnectivity and Security by Satellite). This next-generation satellite constellation aims to bolster Europe's digital sovereignty and provide resilient communication services across the continent. In close cooperation with the EC, ESA is seeking independent expert advice to support the development of strategies and implementation solutions for the IRIS2 Programme. More specifically, a consultancy support is required to promote and initiate the establishment of new partnerships and co-operations for IRIS governmental infrastructure and services with third-party nations to the EU27. In addition, on top of the current system capabilities, the needs for the improvement of the data relay layer of IRIS2 (i.e. linked with the European Resilience System, ERS-COM) for National and International initiatives (constellations) should be investigated as well.
